policy.retentionRiskAction: ON DELETE RESTRICT or immutable lifecycle guard
policy.productionApplication: forward-only via #627 convergence; never destructive QA on production

cascades.retentionDecision: AuditLog is immutable under the #562 lifecycle authority; tenant deletion must fail closed while audit evidence exists.
cascades.recovery: Recover through approved backup/PITR or a future versioned retention policy; generic tenant CRUD cannot erase audit evidence.

cascades.retentionDecision: The snapshot is structurally owned by its ledger line, but #685 additionally protects the snapshot as immutable lifecycle history.
cascades.recovery: Deletion remains blocked by immutable lifecycle policy unless a future approved purge policy supersedes the baseline.

cascades.retentionDecision: FX ledger snapshots are immutable historical evidence and are protected directly by #685 before tenant cleanup may proceed.
cascades.recovery: Use approved restore/PITR or a future versioned lifecycle policy; direct tenant cascade is fail closed.

cascades.retentionDecision: Fiscal close evidence is already immutable under #562 and blocks accidental tenant cascades.
cascades.recovery: Restore from approved evidence/backup workflow; no generic destructive recovery path is permitted.

cascades.retentionDecision: Fiscal documents are already immutable under #562 and therefore survive accidental tenant deletion attempts.
cascades.recovery: Restore through approved backup/PITR; any future purge requires a separately approved versioned retention policy.

cascades.retentionDecision: Captured fiscal rule snapshots are immutable evidence; #685 adds lifecycle protection before tenant cleanup.
cascades.recovery: Fail closed and restore from approved backup/PITR; no generic CRUD deletion is allowed.

cascades.retentionDecision: Versioned fiscal rules are historical regulatory evidence; #685 adds immutable lifecycle protection.
cascades.recovery: Recover through approved backup/PITR or a superseding versioned retention policy, never tenant CRUD.

cascades.retentionDecision: FiscalSequence is mutable counter state rather than issued fiscal evidence; issued documents and rule snapshots remain separately protected.
cascades.recovery: Sequence state is reconstructed only through controlled platform recovery using retained fiscal evidence and documented numbering authority.

cascades.retentionDecision: LedgerEntry is immutable under #562, so tenant deletion cannot accidentally erase ledger history.
cascades.recovery: Restore through approved accounting backup/PITR; generic tenant CRUD remains denied.

cascades.retentionDecision: Ledger lines are structural children of LedgerEntry; parent lifecycle immutability is the deletion authority.
cascades.recovery: Recover the complete ledger aggregate from approved backup/PITR; child rows are never independently purged as posted history.

cascades.retentionDecision: Legal acceptance evidence becomes immutable under #685 so tenant cascade cannot erase acceptance history.
cascades.recovery: Fail closed; restore from approved backup/PITR or future legal-policy authority, never generic tenant CRUD.

cascades.retentionDecision: Deleting a user must not erase legal acceptance evidence; #685 keeps the existing relation contract but blocks the cascade through the immutable LegalAcceptance lifecycle guard.
cascades.recovery: Identity deletion requires an explicit lifecycle/privacy process that preserves required legal evidence and documents any approved transformation.

cascades.retentionDecision: Deleting a tax period must not silently erase declarations; #685 blocks both parent and direct deletes through immutable TaxPeriod/TaxDeclaration lifecycle guards without changing the Prisma FK contract.
cascades.recovery: Tax history is restored from approved backup/PITR; purge requires a future versioned policy and legal review.

cascades.retentionDecision: Tax periods become immutable lifecycle history under #685, blocking accidental tenant cascades.
cascades.recovery: Restore from approved backup/PITR or supersede through a reviewed lifecycle policy; generic deletion remains denied.

cascades.retentionDecision: Deleting an auth user must not erase BudgetWallet audit evidence; #685 changes the FK to ON DELETE RESTRICT when the supplemental table exists.
cascades.recovery: Preserve audit evidence and use an explicit identity/lifecycle process; production rollout is coordinated through #627.

cascades.retentionDecision: Deleting an auth user must not erase Hípico audit events; #685 changes the FK to ON DELETE RESTRICT when present.
cascades.recovery: Preserve audit evidence and use explicit identity lifecycle procedures rather than parent cascade deletion.

cascades.retentionDecision: Deleting a workspace must not erase Hípico audit evidence; #685 changes the FK to ON DELETE RESTRICT when present.
cascades.recovery: Workspace retirement must preserve referenced audit history and use an explicit lifecycle operation if deletion is ever approved.
